Primary report includes methods, results, discussion and references, rather than abstract-only material. No PDF was supplied, so pagination/layout cannot be checked. Assigned field only: es_value_o. Multiple Experiment 1 printed candidates remain: response-time congruency partial eta squared .69, F(1,33)=74.14, p<.001; accuracy congruency partial eta squared .25, F(1,33)=10.99, p<.005; task-by-congruency accuracy interaction partial eta squared .23, F(1,33)=9.76, p<.005; accuracy task main effect partial eta squared .32, F(1,33)=15.66, p<.001. Canonical metric is printed as η followed by 2 and p on separate lines (partial eta squared), not plain eta squared.
